verdict.rationale: The evidence shows targeting rules that are evaluated per request in the SDK, and a release plan that ramps a rule automatically over time. That is a time-based schedule, not an event-triggered action. Nothing in the pack documents user-defined rules that fire actions when events occur, such as event triggers, outbound webhooks or automation workflows. Automating flag toggles from a deploy script through the REST API is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Release plan (optional) — a value-serving rule can ramp up automatically over time instead of switching on all at once.
